Guangdong UNIPOE IoT Technology Co., Ltd. (UNIPOE) was established in January 2014. It’s a global leader in the development and manufacturing of Data Center Switches, L2/L3
Managed Switches, and PoE products. Our core specialization encompasses Network Switches, Injectors, and Splitters, and an ever-expanding portfolio encompassing 100G and
400G Data Center and Cloud Computing Switches. We offer a wide range of products and OEM/ODM/JDM value-added services to meet the needs of the loT market. Furthermore, we
are also deeply committed to the realm of digital transformation. At present, we are actively engaged in the strategic planning and deployment of operational systems, encompassing
CRM, PLM, SRM, ERP, WMS, MES, uCOP, HRM, ITSM and BI systems.
Our manufacturing facility, located in Dongguan City, covers an area of more than 12,000 square meters, and with a monthly production capacity of over 250,000 pcs. With a decade of
dedicated growth, we have become a member of the OCP (Open Compute Project) COMMUNITY, together with communications and cloud computing giants such as ARISTA, Huawei,
H3C, Nokia, BROADCOM, Amazon, and Google, we are focused on redesigning hardware technology to efficiently support the growing demands on IT infrastructure, Moreover, we've
achieved prestigious certifications including ISO19001, ISO14001, ISO45001, ISO27001, ISO14064 and QC080000. Today we have over 300 staff, including 30% software and
hardware development engineers.
Pioneers of groundbreaking innovations, we invented the "LCD PoE Switch" and the "Reverse Power Supply PoE Switch”. Till today with accumulated a total of 115 national patents
and 4 international patents. All our products adhere to rigorous international standards and hold certifications such as CE, FCC, UL, ETL, CCC, UKCA, KC, CB, RCM and RoHS
approvals. These products find wide application in various loT scenarios, including CCTV surveillance, Wi-Fi coverage, VoIP phone systems, smart enterprises, smart cities, and smart
communities. Over the past decade, we have exported our products to more than 20 countries across North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, etc.
